remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained 1,753 sq ft 2-storey single-family home in the sought-after community of Webber Greens! The bright, open-concept main floor features hardwood flooring, a spacious living room with a cozy gas fireplace, a 2-piece powder room, main-floor laundry, and a generous kitchen equipped with a granite-topped island, ample cabinetry, and a walk-in pantry. The dining area opens onto a large deck overlooking a fully fenced backyard with no back lane. Upstairs offers a large bonus room, 3 spacious bedrooms, and 2 full bathrooms, including a 4-piece primary ensuite with a soaker tub. Complete with an unfinished basement ready for your personal touch and an attached double garage with 220V power, steps from parks, golf, schools, shopping, and Anthony Henday Drive (id:67522)
